decision: The product hunk renames the modern system-token class mixin and typography, corner, border and shadow selectors, while the other hunks update upstream demos and build files. The finite historical facade exports its owned core and core themes, not the newer system-classes entry; the Material 16 core/theme sources implement historical styling. Do not copy this modern API into the legacy facade. Verify historical core CSS and mixed M2/M3 inclusion in rendered consumer cases; no compiled or rendered equivalence is claimed.
